response.justification: While Bogdan brings 20 years of software development experience and strong engineering practices (TDD, agile, code quality), he is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirements. His C++ expertise is dormant (10+ years since last professional work at National Instruments in 2014-2015), and his career has pivoted decisively toward web development (Node.js/TypeScript) for the past 8+ years. Critically, there is no demonstrated experience in multi-threaded systems, message brokers, MQTT, secure development lifecycle, IEC 62443 standards, or industrial automation—all central to this position.
strengths: 20 years of professional software development experience across diverse domains demonstrates sustained capability and adaptability
Strong commitment to software quality and engineering excellence through TDD, CI/CD, agile methodologies, and knowledge mentoring
Proven experience designing and implementing event-driven, distributed system architectures (GISCollective platform)
concerns: C++ expertise has been inactive for 10+ years (last professional C++ work ended mid-2015); entire recent career focused on web technologies (Node.js/TypeScript)
No demonstrated experience with security practices, IEC 62443 standards, secure development lifecycle, or industrial cybersecurity—all core requirements
Missing critical technical competencies: multi-threading, concurrent programming, message brokers, MQTT protocol, IoT, and industrial automation domain knowledge

key_factors.factor: Career trajectory away from systems programming
